item.title: Gary Waddock departs for Wealdstone
item.description: We can confirm that Assistant Head Coach Gary Waddock has departed the club to join National League side Wealdstone as their new Manager. Gary joined the Saddlers in June 2023 and has been a key part of Mat Sadler's backroom staff ever since, providing invaluable guidance and experience along the way and showcasing his knowledge of the game in abundance. item.title: Willis previews encounter with Lichfield City
item.description: Walsall Women Head Coach Matt Willis is feeling confident of his side’s chances ahead of their clash against Lichfield City Women on Sunday afternoon. item.title: Match Report: Shrewsbury Town 1-2 Walsall
item.description: Walsall secured victory for the first time since the middle of January as a brace from Priestley Farquharson helped see off an in-form Shrewsbury Town side at Croud Meadow. The Saddlers opened the scoring through Farquharson before the Shrews levelled on the brink of half time, but the defender grabbed a brace after the interval, handing an important three points to the Saddlers. item.title: Instant reaction: Head Coach Mat Sadler discusses victory over Shrewsbury Town
item.description: Mat Sadler made sure to thank the supporters on Saturday afternoon as his side were victorious in a local derby over Shrewsbury Town.
